question: A group of 30 students appeared in a test. The average score of 12 students is 62, and that of the rest is 62. What is the average score of the group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If a group is divided into multiple sub-groups and the average of each sub-group is identically the same, then the combined overall average remains unchanged.

The average score of the first 12 students is 62.

The average score of the remaining 18 students is also 62.

Since both parts of the group share the exact same average, the overall average of all 30 students will directly be 62.

**∴ The correct answer is 62.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Total number of students in the group = 30

⇒ Average score of the first 12 students = 62

⇒ Average score of the remaining students (30 − 12 = 18) = 62
